achievements.name: Companions
achievements.detail: Set out across the world with the companions who join your party.

achievements.name: Vision Called
achievements.detail: Call a Vision, an echo of a classic hero, into battle alongside your party.

achievements.name: Enemy Staggered
achievements.detail: Hit an enemy weakness until that foe staggers. The character who did it gains a bonus action.

achievements.name: Resonance Attack
achievements.detail: Stagger every enemy in one turn, then spend the Vision Resonance that follows.

achievements.name: Vision Party
achievements.detail: Field a party that mixes your companions with more than one Vision.

achievements.name: Esper
achievements.detail: Meet an esper and have it take part in your travels.

achievements.name: Sanctum of Light
achievements.detail: Visit a Sanctum of Light and obtain a vision crystal.

achievements.name: Airship
achievements.detail: Board an airship and fly to another reach of the map.

achievements.name: Limit Burst
achievements.detail: Fill a limit gauge by staggering a foe or taking damage, then unleash that character's Limit Burst.

achievements.name: Vision Awakened
achievements.detail: Spend magicite to awaken a Vision and unlock a stronger ability.

achievements.name: Mighty Foe
achievements.detail: Defeat a powerful monster that watches over a cavern and collect its magicite.

achievements.name: Secret Dungeon
achievements.detail: Clear an optional high-difficulty dungeon that is not part of the main story.
